note: Seasons and weather (doc 10). weather.seasons: per-season mood odds (clear, cloud, rain, mist; renormalized) and rainKind ('rain' or 'drizzle': winter swaps rain for cold drizzle, no snow). Leaning scales rain and mist odds by (1 + leanStep * lean), clear and cloud absorb the difference. weather.rainKinds: startH and hours are integer game-hour ranges [min, max] inclusive, kept inside the day; intensity is the 0..1 rain level while it falls; cloud is the overcast cover all day; mmPerHourAtFull turns intensity into rainAmount (mm). weather.moods: per-mood cloud cover range [min, max] (rolled per day) and wind strength range 0..1. weather.mist: peak density, startH when it forms, formHours to reach peak, hours = rolled total duration from startH [min, max], fadeHours to burn off at the end. weather.wind: prevailingDir in radians (direction the wind blows toward, 0 = +X east, pi/2 = -Z north), dirSpread = +- jitter, diurnalAmount = share of strength that follows the day curve peaking at peakH. blendMinutes: display blend around hour boundaries. dormancy: season-position windows [from, to] where 0 = start of spring, 1 summer, 2 autumn, 3 winter, 4 = next spring; a window with to <= from wraps through the new year. dragonflies: they wait for warm water, so the adults fly from the start of summer into autumn; the rest of the year they are nymphs in the pond (docs 12, and 13: The year, season by season).
